proofs.title: Two live users
proofs.browser: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.7922.34 Safari/537.36

assertions.label: Texture reached WebGL
assertions.detail: The assertion checks a native WebGLTexture, not only a JavaScript object.

assertions.label: First release preserved sharing
assertions.detail: 0 disposal events occurred after user one.

notes: Blind eager disposal would invalidate the resource still used by the second mesh.
Reference counting matters here because both users are genuine owners.

proofs.title: Loader cache reuse
proofs.browser: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.7922.34 Safari/537.36

assertions.label: First user released safely
assertions.detail: The second user retained the original WebGL texture.

assertions.label: Cache outlived all users
assertions.detail: Zero mounted users did not imply cache eviction.

assertions.label: Remount reused the allocation
assertions.detail: The cached result returned with the same WebGL handle.

assertions.label: Final eviction disposed once
assertions.detail: 3 geometry, material and texture disposal events were recorded.

notes: The cache is an explicit owner, not an invisible exception.
Direct useLoader.clear calls are intentionally excluded from the guarded contract.

proofs.title: Canvas remount
proofs.browser: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.7922.34 Safari/537.36

assertions.label: Scene resources released
assertions.detail: 9 owned resources were disposed across 3 remounts.

assertions.label: Renderer contexts closed
assertions.detail: 3 of 3 WebGL contexts reported a forced loss.

notes: Dispose Guard owns scene resources only.
The Canvas host must still dispose its renderer and release the WebGL context.

proofs.title: Shared churn
proofs.browser: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.7922.34 Safari/537.36

assertions.label: Handle survived every hand-off
assertions.detail: One texture survived 50 overlapping consumer transitions.

notes: The test acquires the next consumer before releasing the previous one.
A fixed cache protection makes the intended lifetime explicit.

proofs.title: In-flight eviction
proofs.renderer: R3F loader cache, no renderer required
proofs.browser: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.7922.34 Safari/537.36

assertions.label: Pending request observed
assertions.detail: The guard registered the request before the loader callback resolved.

assertions.label: Late result did not re-enter cache
assertions.detail: Eviction marked the pending generation as stale.

notes: The underlying request is not cancelled because Three.js loaders do not share one cancellation API.
The stale result is adopted long enough to run deterministic cleanup.
